sn38.13:1.6: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.13:1.7: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.13:1.8: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.13:1.9: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāya. seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.13:1.11: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāyāti.
sn38.13:1.12: bhaddako panāvuso maggo, bhaddikā paṭipadā etesaṃ bhavānaṃ pariññāya.
